summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the Thompson Health Region’s logo, from its 1999–2001 letterheads in the City of Merritt’s council agendas, with the symbol’s colours from a 2003 Environment Canada publication. The reconstructions are in proposed-assets.json; the 2000 and 2001 letterheads and the 2003 colour image are added here as dated images beside them. See README.md and package-README.md.

assets.label: Thompson Health Region: letterhead, 9 June 2000
assets.sourceLocator: Letter of 9 June 2000 in the City of Merritt’s council agenda of 27 June 2000, PDF page 110, the letterhead
assets.dateNote: The letter’s own date: a sighting of the logo, not its adoption.
assets.notes: The logo at the head of a letter of 9 June 2000, in black.
assets.fidelityNote: A crop of the agenda’s scanned page, kept as found; its tagline has largely dropped out in the scan.

assets.label: Thompson Health Region: letterhead, 1 November 2001
assets.sourceLocator: Letter of 1 November 2001 in the City of Merritt’s council agenda of 13 November 2001, PDF page 53, the letterhead
assets.dateNote: The letter’s own date: a sighting of the logo, not its adoption.
assets.notes: The logo at the head of a letter of 1 November 2001, in black.
assets.fidelityNote: A crop of the agenda’s scanned page, kept as found.

assets.label: Thompson Health Region: the symbol in colour, 2003
assets.sourceLocator: Proceedings of the Risk Assessment Workshop, Environment Canada, Pacific and Yukon Region [2003] (En40-240-1/03-00E-PDF), PDF page 71, printed page 63, slide 38: the symbol on a regional order to the City of Kamloops
assets.dateNote: The publication’s year; it reproduces earlier regional material.
assets.notes: The symbol alone in teal and ochre, the only colour specimen found.
assets.fidelityNote: The publication’s own 59 × 56 px image, its two 59 × 28 strips joined, pixels unchanged.
